list.title: Git: Submodules
list.subheading: Use Cases, Pros and Cons, Best Practices, and Pitfalls
list.excerpt: Git submodules let you embed one Git repository inside another and pin it to a specific commit. This guide (as of 2019-05-30) covers when submodules shine, where they hurt, practical workflows, best practices, and common pitfalls-so you can decide if they're the right tool for your project.
